Terms and Conditions

1. Acceptance of Terms. By creating an account, you agree to use this system solely for legitimate business record-keeping and management purposes.

2. Your Data. All business data you enter (stock, sales, purchases, customers, debts, etc.) belongs to you. You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you record.

3. Account Security. You are responsible for keeping your password and any PINs you set confidential. You are responsible for all activity that happens under your account, including actions taken by Sellers you add to your business.

4. Acceptable Use. You agree not to use this system for any unlawful purpose, to store data belonging to others without permission, or to attempt to disrupt or gain unauthorized access to any part of the system.

5. Availability. While every reasonable effort is made to keep the service available and your data safe, the service is provided "as is" without guarantee of uninterrupted availability.

6. Changes. These terms may be updated from time to time. Continued use of the system after changes means you accept the updated terms.

7. Termination. An account may be suspended or removed if it is used in a way that violates these terms or applicable law.

My Security PIN

Set a PIN only you know - it's required to unlock the Record Sale form, and (for Sellers) to complete a purchase, so no one else can do it without your permission. Works even offline.

Seller Purchase PINs

Sellers protect "Complete Purchase" with their own PIN, which you can never see. If a Seller forgets theirs, reset it here - they'll be asked to set a new one.
